# User-Initiated Lambdas
IssueStatus and RevokeStatus are triggered by client requests. PublishStatusList propagates those changes downstream.

tiles.name: Markdown
tiles.markdown:
## Cold Starts
Per user-initiated function. Frequent cold starts degrade user-perceived latency.

## Memory Usage
Max memory used vs allocated — highlights over/under-provisioning.

## Correlation View
Publish volume should track with Issue + Revoke activity.

## Init Duration
Cold start initialisation time per function — how long the runtime takes to bootstrap.

# Scheduled Lambdas
RenewStatusLists and RotateSigningKeys run on schedules. ValidateConfiguration is triggered during deployments.

---

**Column Descriptions**

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Traffic - Invocations | Total invocations split by function name. Shows request volume. |
| Latency - Duration | Worst-case (Max, blue) and typical (Avg, yellow) execution time (ms) on one chart. Thresholds: green <4s, yellow 4-5s, red >5s. |
| Saturation - Concurrency | Max concurrent executions vs the function's reserved concurrency limit. Thresholds are per function at ~50% (yellow) and ~80% (red) of the limit: issue-status & revoke-status (limit 200) yellow 100 / red 160; publish-status-list (limit 100) yellow 50 / red 80; renew-status-lists, rotate-signing-keys & validate-configuration (limit 1) red at 1. Reaching 100% is surfaced by the Throttles column. |
| Saturation - Throttles | Throttled invocations. Any non-zero value = capacity pressure. |
| Errors - Error Count | Invocations that resulted in errors (function + runtime errors). |
| Cold Starts | Count of cold-start initialisations (derived from init duration metric). Frequent cold starts degrade user-perceived latency. |
| Memory Usage | Max memory used per function. Helps identify over/under-provisioning. |
| Correlation | PublishStatusList invocations overlaid with Issue+Revoke - publish volume should track upstream demand. |
